description: This plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different neural network layers, using a threshold of 1e-3. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale with data ranging from layer 0 to 23, featuring numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" on a linear scale, with visible values ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 and tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2. A blue dashed line without markers represents the "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003." This line begins at approximately 0.02 at layer 0, immediately drops to nearly 0.0 by layer 1, and maintains a steady, flat trend at 0.0 through the remainder of the x-axis, ending at 0.0 at layer 23. An orange dotted line with no markers represents the "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126." It starts at a peak value of roughly 0.84 at layer 0, declines steeply to about 0.42 at layer 1, and continues decreasing to approximately 0.17 at layer 4. It then gradually tapers off, remaining low between 0.02 and 0.05 from layer 10 to 20, exhibits a small peak near 0.07 at layer 21, and ends at approximately 0.05 at layer 23. A green dash-dot line without markers represents the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080." It starts at roughly 0.78 at layer 0, declines sharply to about 0.28 at layer 1, and steadily decreases to approximately 0.04 at layer 7. Beyond layer 7, the line remains nearly flat, fluctuating very slightly near 0.01, and ends at approximately 0.0 at layer 23.
